plan.summary: Startup no longer loads the zip library. `exportAll` in `src/export.ts` now loads `zip-lib` with a dynamic `import()` only when the `zip` flag is true.
plan.riskRationale: One-line change that moves a module load to call time. Behavior stays the same, but an import failure now shows at export time and not at startup.
plan.storyArc: The PR cuts startup cost by moving the zip library load into the one code path that needs it.

topics.title: Load zip-lib lazily inside exportAll
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `exportAll` get `Zip` now, and when is the library loaded? Verify that the old top-level static import was removed (the PR shows 1 deletion) and that no other code uses `Zip`.
